stories.title: Emergenza su volo British Airways per Chicago, aereo rientra a Londra

en.title: Emergency on British Airways flight to Chicago, aircraft returns to London
en.summary: A British Airways flight bound for Chicago declared a general emergency and reversed course to return to London Heathrow during descent. The crew activated emergency code 7700 to signal the situation.

stories.title: Rai, sanzione disciplinare per Sigfrido Ranucci: sospeso per 10 giorni. A ore scelta sul reintegro

en.title: Rai imposes disciplinary sanction on Sigfrido Ranucci: suspended for 10 days. Reinstatement decision to follow
en.summary: Sigfrido Ranucci has been suspended for 10 days by Rai following disciplinary proceedings. A labor court will decide on his reinstatement, with the broadcaster citing four separate allegations against the journalist.

stories.title: Ranucci sospeso per dieci giorni dalla Rai

en.title: Ranucci suspended for ten days by Rai
en.summary: Sigfrido Ranucci received a ten-day suspension from Rai based on four disciplinary charges against him.

stories.title: Un volo Londra-Chicago sta rientrando a Heathrow in emergenza

en.title: A London-Chicago flight is returning to Heathrow in emergency
en.summary: A flight between London and Chicago is returning to Heathrow airport following an emergency. The cause of the situation remains unclear as the aircraft flies back over the English Channel.

stories.title: La Rai sospende Ranucci per dieci giorni: ecco le contestazioni

en.title: Rai suspends Ranucci for ten days: here are the charges
en.summary: The Italian broadcaster Rai has suspended journalist and former Report host Ranucci for a ten-day period.

stories.title: Emergenza sul volo British Airways Londra-Chicago, l’aereo rientra a Heathrow

en.title: Emergency on British Airways London-Chicago flight, plane returns to Heathrow
en.summary: A Boeing aircraft made a rapid descent and lost approximately 28,000 feet of altitude during a flight from London to Chicago, prompting the pilot to return to Heathrow airport.

stories.title: Ranucci sospeso dalla Rai per 10 giorni, dalle mail a Lavitola agli ingressi in azienda: le contestazioni

en.title: Ranucci suspended by Rai for 10 days, from emails to Lavitola to company access: the charges
en.summary: Rai suspended journalist Ranucci for ten days following disciplinary charges issued by the broadcaster's ethics committee in September.

stories.title: Il primo turno delle presidenziali in Brasile, avanti Bolsonaro: ribaltati i pronostici pro-Lula

en.title: First round of Brazilian presidential election, Bolsonaro ahead: pro-Lula predictions overturned
en.summary: In Brazil's first round of presidential voting, incumbent Bolsonaro performed better than expected, setting up a second round on October 25 where the outcome remains uncertain.

stories.title: Sanchez porta la Spagna al voto il 29 novembre sull'onda delle proteste per la crisi abitativa

en.title: Sanchez calls Spanish election for 29 November amid housing crisis protests
en.summary: Spain's prime minister has scheduled elections for November 29, seeking to capitalize on public support through housing measures after widespread protests over an acute housing shortage.

stories.title: "Io sono Giorgia Meloni": contro i fake la premier registra la sua voce all'ufficio marchi Euipo

en.title: "I am Giorgia Meloni": Italy's premier registers her voice with EU trademark office against AI deepfakes
en.summary: Italy's prime minister has filed a trademark application with the EU intellectual property office to protect her name and voice from artificial intelligence-generated cloning attempts.

stories.title: Nobel per la Medicina a Deisseroth, Hegemann e Nagel per aver gettato le basi dell'optogenica

en.title: Nobel Prize in Medicine awarded to Deisseroth, Hegemann and Nagel for founding optogenetics
en.summary: Three scientists received the Nobel Prize for developing optogenetics, a technique that has enabled researchers to identify neural circuits controlling specific memories, emotions, and behaviors linked to neurological and psychiatric disorders.

stories.title: Nobel 2026 per la Medicina a Deisseroth, Hegemann e Nagel per gli studi sull’optogenetica

en.title: 2026 Nobel Prize in Medicine to Deisseroth, Hegemann and Nagel for optogenetics studies
en.summary: Three researchers received the Nobel Prize for Medicine for developing optogenetics, a discipline that combines genetic and optical techniques.

stories.title: Ericsson, ritirati i 131 licenziamenti a Genova dopo l’intervento di Meloni

en.title: Ericsson withdraws 131 layoffs in Genoa following Meloni's intervention
en.summary: Ericsson has canceled planned layoffs of 131 workers in Genoa after direct action by Italy's prime minister, halting the dismissal procedure.

stories.title: Nucleare pulito, consegnato l’ultimo settore Ue del reattore a fusione Iter

en.title: Clean nuclear, last EU sector of Iter fusion reactor delivered
en.summary: Fusion for Energy, along with Ansaldo Nucleare, Westinghouse Electric Company, and Walter Tosto, completed a major sector component for the Iter fusion reactor project.

stories.title: Electrolux ritira i licenziamenti unilaterali: nuovo piano con incentivi all’esodo e ammortizzatori sociali

en.title: Electrolux withdraws unilateral layoffs: new plan with incentives for voluntary departures and social safety nets
en.summary: Electrolux has withdrawn unilateral redundancy notices and presented a new restructuring plan featuring voluntary departure incentives and social protection measures. A further negotiation meeting was scheduled for October 29.

stories.title: Pelle umana stampata in 3D, a Bio System Lab il Premio Digithon

en.title: Human skin 3D printed at Bio System Lab wins Digithon Prize
en.summary: Bio System Lab, a startup from Treviso, won a major prize for its patent on vascularized human skin produced through 3D printing, described as the world's first of its kind.

stories.title: Ex Ilva, la Corte d’Appello di Milano conferma il blocco degli altiforni

en.title: Ex Ilva, Milan Court of Appeal confirms blast furnace shutdown
en.summary: Milan's Court of Appeal rejected a second suspension request regarding the decree blocking the hot area operations at the former Ilva steelworks in Taranto, upholding the blast furnace shutdown.
